short: Free Rice, AP Photo, Google Alert…
notes: Probes: Free Rice 1.01, Google Alert 0.81, Public Holiday 0.76, AP Photo 0.67. Close variants did not fire: Bank Holiday 0.06, Amber Alert 0.01, Reuters Photo 0.09, Google Maps 0.02, Red Cross 0.01, Tourist/More Information 0.01 (although ' Information' leads the card's peak tokens), lowercase 'public holiday' 0.28. So the pole reads specific bigrams, and I found no rule that predicts which. The near misses are those close variants.
